facts.fact: TechHive Advisory reports the Data Protection Act was enacted in December 2023, repealing the unimplemented 2003 Act, with an 18-month transition period for controllers and processors to comply.

TechHive Advisory reports section 5 of the Act designates the existing Information Commission as the regulatory body enforcing the Act, with powers to investigate, audit, fine and issue enforcement notices.
